description:
Find notes and logs and summarise thread activity; returns absolute paths plus metadata, never file bodies.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread THREAD] [--type TYPE] [--text TEXT] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — find notes
  logs [--thread THREAD] [--text TEXT] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — find daily logs
  activity [--thread THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — rank threads by what happened in a window
  overview THREAD [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — whole picture of one thread
  stream [--thread THREAD] [--kind KINDS] [--text TEXT] [--today] [--reverse] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — every dated record merged into one chronology

Flags:
  all subcommands:
    --since YYYY-MM-DD / --until YYYY-MM-DD  inclusive bounds
    --thread THREAD  thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink (overview takes it as positional THREAD)
    --json  JSON output
  notes:
    --type TYPE  note type, e.g. Meeting; case-insensitive
    --text TEXT  case-insensitive literal over topic and body
    --limit N  default 20; 0 = all
  logs:
    --text TEXT  case-insensitive literal over entry lines
    --limit N  default 20; 0 = all
  overview:
    --limit N  recent items listed; default 5; 0 = all
  stream:
    --kind KINDS  comma-separated subset of note, log, task, done, hours, payment, thread, person, pending; default all
    --text TEXT  case-insensitive literal over thread and summary
    --today  only today (since and until today)
    --reverse  oldest first; default newest first
    --limit N  default 100; 0 = all

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--type", "Meeting", "--since", "2026-09-01", "--json"]
  ["logs", "--text", "invoice", "--limit", "0"]
  ["overview", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["stream", "--today", "--kind", "note,log,task"]

Notes:
  Dates filter on the event date (note frontmatter timestamp), not the date the file was written.
  notes/logs --text do not search hours entry descriptions.
  Open a result by its printed path, or with notes cat STEM.
  Exit 1: unknown --kind value.
